environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer configured with mutual TLS authentication. The ALB listener on port 443 has a trust store association (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/corp-ca-bundle/ts-0a1b2c3d4e5f) with verify mode set to 'verify' (not 'passthrough'). The trust store contains only the corporate intermediate CA certificate (CN=CorpServices Issuing CA G2, O=Example Corp). Client connections without a valid certificate signed by this CA chain receive a TLS handshake failure at the ALB layer before any traffic reaches the target group. Additionally, the ECS task runs in a private subnet with a NAT gateway that has a Network Firewall stateful rule group (arn:aws:network-firewall:us-east-1:123456789012:stateful-rulegroup/egress-allowlist) restricting outbound HTTP/HTTPS to a domain allowlist (*.googleapis.com, *.github.com, login.microsoftonline.com, token-service.internal). The task security group restricts outbound to the NAT gateway prefix list and the internal service discovery namespace only.

alb_mutual_tls.ca_subject: CN=CorpServices Issuing CA G2, O=Example Corp

network_firewall_egress.protocol_inspection: TLS SNI and HTTP Host header

config.subnet: private, no IGW route, NAT via Network Firewall inspection VPC
